reviews.title: More than worst
reviews.text: Worst of the worsts how they keep flying it is unbelievible.no respect nothing.all old aircrafts....
reviews.author: Pegasus

reviews.title: Not a pleasant experience.
reviews.text: Worst flight of my life. It has been 3 years ago by now, and I still have nightmares. The planes were held together by tape it seems, which must be the reason we're still alive. I owe my life to tape. Moist was dripping from the ceiling, and there was little to no room for your legs, so if you're a tall person don't take a flight with Onur air unless you want to have back pain for the entire holiday. The staff wasn't friendly: a stewardess literally cried when the plane took off, I thought we were going to die. We had flight delays on the way to Turkey and back. The latter being a 5-hour delay due to technical difficulties. I will never take a flight with this company again, because I didn't feel safe. We didn't receive any decent food when waiting on the airfield. Cold fries with chicken isn't pleasant to eat. Also, the plane shook a lot when we took off, I've never experienced that much shaking again when taking a flight. It was scary. Never again!
reviews.author: Greet K

reviews.title: Don’t fly with holiday Europe
reviews.text: Literally everything in this old and dirty airbus was broken and fixed with tape. We were flying in corona, none of the employees does worry about that. Furthermore the space to sit was way to limited, those who have long legs are stuck between the chairs, really. Even Ryan Air has more space between chairs............. I will never fly again with holiday Europe.
reviews.author: Mark v

reviews.title: Avoid Holiday Europe!
reviews.text: Does Corona exists on your flights? Maybe take some action! Furthermore, how old are those plains literally everything was broken is this Airbus.
reviews.author: Damian

reviews.title: Guess what! If the flight is cheap, were do they safe that money? Onur Air lost our baggage one year ago
reviews.text: Onur Air lost our baggage one year ago – and still no confirmation of that lost We flew from Munich to Marsa Alam (booked via Fly2Sky) and operated by Onur Air. Onur Air lost our baggage (with our diving equipment) and did not – more than one year later (it was in July 2019, but I cannot select July in the check bos) – confirmed they lost of our baggage. This confirmation is a must for our travelling insurance to pay the value of the lost baggage. Fact: We paid Onur Air to transport fly us and our baggage to Marsa Alam. They failed in that! And then, they are not able to just send us something written, that the baggage is lost. But guys, if you want to fly cheap – than its also your fault if you get a cheap process and customer service, right?!?
reviews.author: mannag

reviews.title: Worst flight ever
reviews.text: Onur air has bought some aircrafts from Saudi Arabia which were decommissioned by saudia. The aircrafts are in very bad condition. The cabin crew are rude. The food is bad. The seats aren't cleaned. Very disturbing vibration. The chartered flight was delayed 12 hours. Please let everyone know this... If you want your loved ones to be safe never let them travel in onur air... Spent 650 euro just for charter. The worst travel experience in my life...we had 9 hours flight and they just gave us a bread and a juice. Shame on onur air... Please ban them. No one deserves such terrible service for 650 euros... Please stay away from this scam airline.
reviews.author: Sayid abuka

reviews.title: Definitely worst of the world
reviews.text: I really have never seen even a coach company like this worst.all aircrafts smells disgusting all ground and customer care,ticketing staff very rude.services and materials on board all disaster.i have travelled to düsseldorf with this company 3 years ago and definetly everything was same worst.i have never see their flight on time.all delayed and no explanation no respect to even their employees at all.cabin crew looks tired and fedup.my recommondation is keep away you and your loved ones from this company,save your time,save your health...
reviews.author: Pegasus

reviews.title: Ignores you completely
reviews.text: We had a delay of almost 4 hours. We did not get anything to eat while the staff of he plane was cooking food for themselves. I sat on the first row and could smell it! That is not even the worst, after contacting them several times, I was ignored! They don't respond to e-mail and they do not have a telephone number to call. It is by far the worst airline I have ever flown with. AVOID IT! DO NOT BOOK A FLIGHT WITH THEM! WARN OTHERS!
reviews.author: Remy D

reviews.title: It's realy subpar
reviews.text: Well,.... it was a package for the vacation so we really didn't have a choice.Check-in OK at the airport but you can not do it on line. We end up 4 people in 4 different seats, at least two were across the aisle.The crew was OK but they had nothing to do , served some water, tea and coffee in an over 4 hours flight. Cleanliness an issue most certainly , toilets run out off napkins before mid flight nobody replaced them. Seat comfort bad,legroom really small, took a toll on everybody especially on the longer nighttime returning flight.The crew spoke english and all the announcements made by the captain were in english , weird if one consider 90%of the passengers were Germans.I would try to avoid them.
reviews.author: atti s

reviews.title: Flight from Tallinn to Sharm EL Sheikh and return with Onur air
reviews.text: Awfull Cabin Crew.Don,t manage people .English was so bad,that people Don,t understand .Security was Zero.When it was told from captain to sit down and fasten the Seat belts because of turbulence ,passengers were standing and walking around and Cabin Crew did nothing.
reviews.author: villem2018

reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: Read bad comments about this airline. The flight was in time. I got water and coffee for free. Staff was friendly. No meals, well i did not book any. No monitors - I had my Ipad with me. The plane was clean, seats not that much space, for a four hour flight just ok.
reviews.author: Wolfgang B

reviews.title: Please avoid if possible
reviews.text: The most unpleasant flight ever. Airplane filthy, leg room is a joke, not enough room for 180cm person. Toilet doesn't meet any standards. Service onboard look like they don't want to be there... Not helpful at all, the only thing which was great was a boarding time. They packed whole plane in 12 minutes - all the time yelling at people to sit down and hurry up. I had this flight as a part of TUI Deutschland holiday trip... TUI, shame on you!
reviews.author: Tom R

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: The plane was old and filthy with no legroom at all. The onboard service was poor: just water coffee or tea and nothing else, even to buy (in a 5 hrs flight), no meal served. During flight we even had an unexpected landing in Istanbul due to technical problems to the plane and we had to change aircraft. Not recommended at all.
reviews.author: Fulvio A

reviews.title: delay
reviews.text: 3 hours delay. seats are very unconfortable. no food available on board. even no hot drinks, only water available during the flight (more than 4 hours).
reviews.author: Roxana

reviews.title: Shame
reviews.text: Flew with this airline in August. I walked with a walker and just wanted to walk to the plane (the return trip). Was taken out of line by employee. I had to follow him and was put on a plane with a special truck. Then the plane did not leave and I was taken out again and put in a hall together with another disabled person. It took 5 hours before we could leave again and my walker was not brought despite several requests. And then I wasn't picked up anymore either. Had to walk without walkernow!! Onur reply to emails only with standard answers. Really outrageous. Also with regard to the compensation that they promise on their own website, they do not keep what they promise. On their own website it is stated that they pay it, but when asked, they indicate that they do not reimburse if you leave from Turkey. Shame!
reviews.author: Joost M

reviews.title: OK but no thrills Airline
reviews.text: After I read the previous comments I was not really looking forward to my flight. But all was OK. Departure on time. Planes OK not the newest but so what. I prefer flying with a slightly older plane that did good service than a brand new Boing Max. Twice water and coffe. Nothing else. No food. Maybe they should have told at departure so people could buy food at airport. Yes leg space is minimal but for 4.5 h flight with normal body should not be too difficult. I usually fly business only but this was for a normal holiday and I did not mind at all.
reviews.author: bernie

reviews.title: Excellent "Holiday Europe" Onur Air flight - comfortable - highly recommended
reviews.text: We travel often, are top tier at several hotels and airlines - we are seasoned travellers. And we thoroughly enjoyed the flight. DWC is a much better airport than DXB, the ground staff were awesome. The air crew were very nice and polite. The airplane was new, they had charging slots and USB slots. The crew sold us tea and took USD despite prices being in Euro. There were so many seats empty that we could each take a row and sleep flat. Both the ground crew and the female staff on the plane are deserving of special praise. I just wish they do this on all their flights - we need some competition to Ryan Air and Easyjet - this was better than flying Lufthansa or KLM or British Airways for me.
reviews.author: KK Bhai

reviews.title: I'm happy with the airline !
reviews.text: For the money I paid, it was very good, thank you Onur Air/ Holiday Europe. It was a "Holiday Europe" flight, I believe Onur Air owns nearly half of it. All cabin personnel had Onur Air badges, so that's why I'm doing the review here by Onur Air. I want to thank the stewards and stewardesses for their kind smiles, they were very polite and courteous. And also thank you for the water :) It was a very affordable flight so I didn't know whether we'd have to pay for our water/ tea/ coffee, but thank God they were for free, so thank you, guys !
reviews.author: cs chaka

reviews.title: Flight 5Q 4703  Marsa Alam - Cologne/Duesseldorf on Sunday 15.Dec.2019 (Onur Airlines) Horror Trip,seat bullying
reviews.text: After reaching cruise height, my wife was totally blocked in all movements between a normal reclined seat in front of her and her seat blocked in an upright position due to the knee blockage of the behind sitting person. The blocking lady claimed, "her long legs don`t fit in the seat space and that my wife`s seat must remain upright during the whole flight". She struggled with all force against the required seat relaxation without any commitment. The cabin crew was not able to interfere, due to missing German language knowledge and enforcement against the company sitting next to her, which formed a gang over all 6 seats of this row and on the following rows. When my wife and I were able to change places on own initiative within our row with two understanding passengers, the bullying started aggressively against me, when I tried to recline my new own seat. Knees were pressed into my back with greatest force, hurting me and pressing the seat always back into the upright position. Additionally the German /Dutch gang of this row behind me started combined obscene insults against me. One even blocked and kicked me from going to the lavatory. Again the crew did not interfere. The situation was caused by the crammed plane with totally undersized foot spaces. My evaluation of this flight is: Economy class syndrome (ECS) is highest rated.
reviews.author: Wilfried F

reviews.title: Holiday Europe by Onur Air “please avoid”
reviews.text: One of the worst airlines and aircraft ever travelled with! Holiday Europe uses Onur Air oldest airbus aircraft, all over 20 years old. Aircraft overused, old, dirty. Seat pitch even worse than standard lowcost flights. Seats are old and broken. Whole plane was so dirty. Service was only 1 cup of water and 1/2 cup of coffee on a 5 hours flight. No possibility to buy something. Flight attendants did not appear in the cabin. Please fly another airline!
reviews.author: Japperjas

reviews.title: ONUR  AIR  ancient  aircraft
reviews.text: dreadful experience plane was used to repatriate passengers after thomas cook collapse engine failure and emergency landing back at Dalaman
reviews.author: Chris1973

reviews.title: Vulnerable and dishonest
reviews.text: I booked this flight and you can see the attachments that it was booked with extra amount which allows you to carry excess baggage of 5kilos per ticket and a BAGEL SANDWICH. However even after charging for the same. They didn't give us our paid meal. What kind of cheat is this ? Regard Hirok
reviews.author: Hirok Poddar

reviews.title: Don’t fly with Onur Air!
reviews.text: After my journey with Onur Air I understand all the negative reviews on TripAdvisor. Don’t choose for Onur Air! We had a delay of 2 hours last Sunday, terrible.
reviews.author: Thomas 2

reviews.title: Most awfull experience
reviews.text: Everything started all ready before the flight , when they changed time of flight two times- last one was even 6 hours earlier than expected to get home! We was traveling with 3 years old baby and we had to wake him up at 3 o’clock to get to the airport. On flight from Riga to Antalya - the plane was extremely dirty - mess all around. Toilets stopped working almost an hour before landing! Never ever again!!!
reviews.author: Antra O

reviews.title: rescued by onur air and the british government.
reviews.text: After the collapse of Thomas cook airlines we flew home on onur air with help from the British government we were supplied with hot drinks bottled water and a snack thank you onur air and all who made our return possible
reviews.author: kevinandalma

reviews.title: Worst flight experience.
reviews.text: I’ve had the worst experience in my life. We waited for the flight for 7 hours at the airport of Odessa Ukrain. Officials had nothing to say but just we had to wait. I will never fly again with Onur.
reviews.author: Tansel G

reviews.title: Words fail me!
reviews.text: We were on holiday when Thomas Cook collapsed so our original flight home was no longer available. The CAA were really marvellous getting everyone home and we were allocated seats on an Onur Air flight which was scheduled at almost the same time as our original flight. There were no issues at the airport, we were expecting chaos, everything went well. On boarding, the flight attendants did not acknowledge the passengers or give directions to the seats which is usual, but continued with their private conversations. Their 2 announcements plus the 2 from the pilot given throughout the flight were so brisk that none of us understood what was being said. The lack of interest shown to their passengers was a sight to behold. We were given 2 bottles of water (thank you ) and shortly after take off they came around with hot drinks. This caused great hilarity as the small disposable cups were less than half full and was just not worth the effort. It felt insulting, especially as the staff were so dismissive of the passengers. We hadn't expected to be able to purchase any food on board which was fortunate as we weren't offered any. The crew (aside from a smiley man) did not speak to the passengers unless they had to, but were morose and stony faced. They clearly didn't want to be on duty despite the fact that they were being paid to do their job, they were not there as a charitable act! They appeared to have the attitude that we were beneath them. It is a pity that the staff did not consider that every single passenger that they sneered at, could potentially be future Onur Air customers....and therefore pay their wages. Without customers they would not have a job! Luckily, it is extremely unlikely that we will ever fly with Onur Air again.
reviews.author: Clare M

reviews.title: Extremely Smooth Flight
reviews.text: Like others I’ve read the reviews. The plane did have an issue. We got delayed for take off. About two hours late heading to Germany. They spoke mainly Turkish. There was a worker who spoke some English. I had to get a connection to London from Cologne. I gave myself enough time during lay over just “incase” am I’m glad I did. I wasn’t in a real rush since I thought ahead. My only issue is communication. I wish they would’ve said more instead of keeping everyone in suspense about what was going on. The boarding crew walked off with no one to really answer anyone’s questions. They did say they were going to work on it and return. They were more short about it. In two hours they announced we will be departing! Everyone of course was happy. The process was still a little slow. There was an Onur flight before ours who left as scheduled. I shut my eyes prior to take off since it was so early in the morning and turned into a longer morning. I opened my eyes a few moments after seating and we were in the air already! The flight was so smooth I didn’t even feel the plane take off! The landing was just as smooth. Obviously I was comfortable. Or really tired at this point. I give four stars only due to the communication of the flight delay. I had a great flight and experience. I do recommend this air line! I never heard of it prior to being in Turkey. I will use again when I return!
reviews.author: Rafiki_11

reviews.title: Package holiday
reviews.text: We took the trip from Estonia to Turkey as a package. We were a family of four. The departure flight was delayed for half an hour. That we found out on the same morning. There is no online check in. All the passengers have to check in at the airport. The plane is in average condition. The seats are a bit worn. Leg room was a bit poor. (but im 186cm tall ) The flight crew were nice. English was good. Nothing bad or nothing very good to say.
reviews.author: Ingo L

reviews.title: Absolute Shambles
reviews.text: We were very excited at Munich airport to be allocated seats 1A and 1B for our flight to Antalya - couldn't believe our luck. However when we boarded the flight we discovered that those seats in fact did not exist. For the next 15 minutes or so we (and about 7 others with no seats) we're crammed into the space at the front of the plane whole the flight attendant repeatedly picked up the phone, screamed down it and slammed it down. We were trying all that time to get confirmation that they did in fact have some seats for us, but they were ignoring us and just fighting with ground crew. Finally we were allocated other seats on this clapped out POS plane, but were delayed much further. The pilot made an announcement that it was "not his fault" and that was about it. Kind of concerning to be running an airline when you can't get the basics right. Makes you wonder about the safety. Never again.
reviews.author: Laura L

reviews.title: Dirty worn out plane
reviews.text: Flew this airline as a part of package deal. It started with me tracking the inbound flight from home and seeing the plane was delayed. As I'm always early to the airport, still went to the airport based on the original departure time. However the plane somehow got a bit more delayed. The worst part of this was that the screens at the airport did not show any delay until after the original time. I know how the information system works so I do not blame the airport for this. Onur Air should have updated the arrival time yet they didn't. Then when boarding time finally came, they did the whole boarding group thing. First the rows in the back, then in the middle and then..... they didn't call the front rows. Really strange. Then when everyone was on board, the ground staff came on board, there was a lot of discussion and then they started moving people from the back and the front. They somehow managed to check in the passengers incorrectly so they had to reshuffle to get the weight balance right. This lead to an even longer delay, in the end the plane departed about two hours late. The seat was terrible, it lacked any padding. The seat was very worn out, on my return flight (which was on the same plane) part of the plastic covering on my seat was even loose. The cabin really needs new seats, the worst part was that the headrest was so worn out that you basically lean back, so if you do that you get a stiff neck. So I hope they either refurbish planes like this that they have or replace more of them with A320NEOS which I saw sitting at Antalya airport but didn't get to fly. I imagine the cabin would be better in those anyway.
reviews.author: Börge v

reviews.title: Save flight
reviews.text: The flight from Riga to Antalya and return was on schedule, without delay, the cabin crew were very nice, the leg room was ok. The landing in Riga airport on a return flight was just excellent, bravo to a pilot!
reviews.author: Xenia

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Its good for the price, but there are better chairs on other airlines (Atlas global were better concerning the seating) They didn't offer food, we paid for food and beverages.
reviews.author: Seemon S

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Briefly: there was a problem with buying the souvenir which should be in stock on the board. After I sent my request to customer service, I received the response in one week, which included namely four words. My question was ignored, problem was not solved. Customer service was terrible. Besides the service on the board leaves much to be desired. It seemed that I was traveling by bus with very poor organising. Luckily there are a lot of competent competitors who can provide an adequate service.
reviews.author: Volodymyr B

reviews.title: Incredible manager
reviews.text: We took this direct flight from Bodrum to Paris. It turned out to be a charter flight so no online seat reservation or checkin. Nevertheless the airline manager in the check in counter was most efficient. Her name Ozge. All passengers were swiftly checked in. No problem with luggage. The flight left on time and arrived in a smaller terminal of CHD ex terminal 9. No waiting for the luggage and a fast exit. In 4 hours we were in Paris! Vs traveling a 7 or 8 hour connecting flight.
reviews.author: Ariestennisgirl

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Nice, we got to go into the cockpit and take selfies with very nice pilots, no food but nice quick night flight
reviews.author: Jonny fowler

reviews.title: No leg room, rude staff, horrible service!!
reviews.text: We (M 27, W 21) were flying from Stuttgart to Antalya Airport on the 20.08.2019. The airplane was in a schocking condition. The plane took off and the engines sounded like a broken Opel Corsa. Leg room was not existing at all even though we were sitting on emergency exit what is supposed to be wider. During duration of the flight nothing was included- even not a sip of water. The prices were horrendous. We felt like we are in some animal transport cage to final destination. I went to toilet and the Turkish staff opened the door while i was in there. I have never experienced such a bad service, quality and pricing. Please DO NOT fly with Onurair!!!
reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Very bad
reviews.text: It was a round trip flight from Tbilisi to Antalya by "Onur Air". From Tbilisi the flight delayed more than 2 hours. The cabin was dirty. Distance between chairs was too small. From Antalya to Tbilisi flight, the cabin was clear but smelt awfully. Flight attendants were rood.
reviews.author: George&Eto

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Low cost flight, they don't serve anything on board, for a quick flight, its ok, but nothing special. The flight attendants were ok, trying to smile. A big disadvantage is that they had only one kids menu to buy
reviews.author: Gabika

reviews.title: Worst airplanes ever!!
reviews.text: The worst airplanes ever, they has been cancelled our trip without telling us, and we wait at the airport before 4 hrs to know at last that the trip was cancelled, it is terrible .. Don't even think to try this airplane
reviews.author: Hiba Milhim

reviews.title: Never  again
reviews.text: Flight booked with Balkan Air, changed to Fly 2 Sky, changed to Olympus Air, operated by Onur Air. A Desaster!!!! Nothing to eat, even no Chance to buy anything to eat or to drink excepting water or coffee. The Crew had a very good lunch, the whole plane smells like a bakery, but Nothing for the passengers. Delay more than 1 1/2 hour, depending of late check in. Never again.!!!!!
reviews.author: Susanne801

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Our flight was charter, without service (food and beverage), but airplane was clean and staff, check-in, boarding OK
reviews.author: Mikica66

reviews.title: Never this company
reviews.text: No comments....🤐😕, thanks FerienTouristic for this present....they change fly company for two times and finally found this Turkey company. Look at the photo ... I fly 3 hours looking at this. They clean nothing in the plane...😕🤐🤐🤐😕😕😕😕
reviews.author: Vasile

reviews.title: Hard to find any service
reviews.text: For a budget company it's normal you get less service, but you can't find any service overhere. ven the planes are not serviced (?): Broken chairs - you fall at the passengers lap behind you at run off. Broken arm rests etc. Probably the plane doesn't meet the safety standards. Speaking of standards, there seems te be a standard delay of 1,5 hours.
reviews.author: Caitlin S

reviews.title: Worst Airline
reviews.text: Our flight took off with a delay of 3 hours! Not only that, but they even let us pay for a little can of coke after that 3 hour delay. It took another whole hour for us to get our baggage at the destination airport. Other flights that landed after us, got theirs way faster. If you go to Flightradar24 and search for some of their past flights, you'll see that almost 90% of them have a significant delay. Don't ever fly with them, let them go bankrupt.
reviews.author: Cheesecake

reviews.title: smooth flight
reviews.text: it was a TUI charterflight. We were not expecting much since it is a charter. It was nothing special, we got from A to B with minor delay.
reviews.author: mne

reviews.title: I don't recommend anyone using this airline
reviews.text: The staff is unprofessional and mean, food and drinks aren't free.. They are expensive.. Our depaeture was delayed for a whole day and we were notified only one hour before the flight and our flight back was delayed for 1 hour.. This was my worst experience on a plane
reviews.author: dandounb

reviews.title: Delayed Flights
reviews.text: The only problem was that the flight was 2- 3 hours delayed.Otherwise the food was great(available only on payment). The airline was cleaned. There was no entertain ment system but it was a short flight.Seats and legroom were good. Customer Service was cooperative. This airline is Better for short Flights only
reviews.author: Muhammad Zamir

reviews.title: The worst in the world!
reviews.text: They introduced the lack of the ability to combine luggage (kg). So instead of taking two suitcases of registered luggage, weighing 30 kilograms each and two as hand luggage, I will take 4 registered suitcases, weighing 20 kilos plus hand luggage! This is a stupid idea. First of all, people will take on board more secondly, the check-in will last longer and they will have even greater delays than before !!!!
reviews.author: Ania S

reviews.title: The worst experience ever
reviews.text: Our flight from SOF to AYT was delayed by 4 hrs just 2 min before the onboarding. No one told us anything so we kept waiting for almost an hour at the gate. The kids were screaming and all people got really pissed off because we couldn`t go anywhere without information for the delay. It turned out that the plain was not even on the airport at the set time of the flight. Once it finally landed, the passengers were getting off and we were getting on at the same time. No technical check. Speechless! My baggage got smashed! I barely recognized on the line. The other flight from AYT to SOF was delayed 10 hrs on the day before (less than 12 hrs before the flight) and 1 hour more during the onboarding so we again kept waiting at the gate itself. Very very poor service. I tried to file a claim but couldn`t as the official delays announced were less than 3 hrs. No compensation from the company, not even a bottle of water as a compliment for the suffering.
reviews.author: Zornitsa
